children: The annual inflation rate in Tanzania inched up to 4.3% in August 2026 from 4.2% in July, reaching the highest level since April 2023.

Upward pressure came primarily from prices of transportation (13.8% vs 13.8% in July); education (3.2% vs 2.8%); restaurants & hotels (3% vs 2.7%); furnishings & household equipment (2.6% vs 2.2%) and housing & utilities (2.5% vs 1.6%).
Meanwhile, softer price growth was seen for other CPI items such as food & non-alcoholic beverages (3.7% vs 4.1%) and alcoholic beverages & tobacco (1.5% vs 1.9%).
On a monthly basis, the CPI rose by 0.1% in August, after decreasing by a similar margin in July.

title: Tanzania Inflation Rate Hits Near 3-1/2-Year High
